title: Masse grasse relative (Relative Fat Mass, RFM)
formula:
RFM = 64 – (20 ×notionvc: a79f596b-b5c7-47f0-b26d-d087a663f7ab(height/waist)) + (12 ×notionvc: a79f596b-b5c7-47f0-b26d-d087a663f7absex*)

*sex = 0 for male, 1 for female

how_to_use.why:
- BMI is frequently used to estimate body fat-defined obesity, although it is known to have limited accuracy with distinguishing fat mass from non-fat mass.
- Relative fat mass is a simple equation requiring only two readily available measurements.
- Can avoid misclassification of adults with high muscle mass as obese.
- Shown to predict fat mass percentage more consistently than BMI when compared to gold standard reference measures, such as DEXA.
how_to_use.when: Use this tool to estimate whole body fat percentage in adults ≥20 years of age.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Obesity cut-points in the derivation study were derived based on corresponding first and second quintile values for each sex in the combined NHANES dataset.
- These values correspond to ≥33.9% defining obesity in women and ≥22.8% defining obesity in men.
- This tool was derived in Mexican-American, European-American, and African-American populations. Use caution when calculating RFM in other populations.
- RFM has also been used to estimate risk for cardiovascular disease and diabetes in various populations.

next_steps.advice:
- Les patients répondant aux critères d'obésité doivent bénéficier de conseils pour la modification du mode de vie.
- Tous les patients doivent être encouragés à se tenir à jour des dépistages préventifs et des conseils.

more_info: L'obésité est définie par un RFM ≥ 33,9 % chez les femmes et ≥ 22,8 % chez les hommes.
short_description: Estimation de la masse grasse corporelle
medium_description: Estime le pourcentage de graisse corporelle totale chez les adultes.
